mapper.select: SELECT date, count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM register_mgmt WHERE apply_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY date ) AS subquery

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_apply_count, SUM(IF(status = #{pending}, 1, 0)) AS pending_audit_count, SUM(IF(status = #{admitted}, 1, 0)) AS admitted_count, COUNT(confirm_time) AS confirmed_count FROM register_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND apply_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
